# feat(preview): the preview pane beside the Content Manager form: device widths, "as static site", reload on save

<!-- bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#45 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-plugin-core-45.md -->

Part of #62.

## Why

Decision 3: the side-by-side preview is a page of ours, because Strapi's free Preview is full-screen only and Live Preview does not handle dynamic zones. The artboard "Live preview beside the form" (https://claude.ai/artifact/HANdCR4vzcoCQNmcFA9w64) shows it: the form on the left, the real page on the right, the cost meter above.

## What to build

- Page `/plugins/micelio/preview/:uid/:documentId` (`admin/src/pages/PreviewPage.tsx`): the Content Manager form embedded through Strapi's `unstable_useDocument`/edit view layout where it is stable, otherwise a link back; the iframe on the right with the URL from `GET /micelio/preview-url`, refreshed before expiry.
- Toolbar: device widths (320, 768, 1280), mode toggle "as static site" (decision 8), locale, reload; the iframe reloads after a successful save (`micelio:reload`).
- Selection of a block in the form scrolls the preview to it (`micelio:scrollTo`) using the `micelio:blocks` map; phase 1 has no selection in the other direction.
- Keyboard: every toolbar action has a shortcut from the Shortcuts sheet of the design; the shortcuts never fire inside a field.
- Motion: the tokens of the Motion artboard (120/200/320 ms, reduced motion honoured); the preview cross-fades on reload, the old render stays until the new one is ready.

## Requirements

- Permission `plugin::micelio.preview`; a document the admin may not edit opens read-only with the preview.
- Both locales; axe and keyboard in `npm run test:admin`.
- `feat` → MINOR.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The browser suite opens the page for the seeded landing, sees the iframe load the draft, switches to static and sees the islands' alternatives.
- [ ] Saving the form reloads the preview once.
- [ ] With `prefers-reduced-motion` the cross-fade is 1 ms (asserted on the computed style).
- [ ] axe: 0 violations.
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on the plugin's Docker Compose (`compose.dev.yml`: clean Strapi with the plugin, PostgreSQL and the frontend image), following the steps the PR lists under Tests.

The maintainer reviews the whole diff before merging (standard, sections 11 and 13).
